card.name: Verbs just before a person object
card.fires_on: A transitive verb or verb-plus-preposition that is about to take a person as its object, such as console, judge, support, care for, spying on. It appears in general prose, often religious or social.

modes.label: Care or comfort verbs
modes.description: Verbs of comforting or supporting that are followed by a pronoun like them or her.
modes.example: Jesus had assured the Twelve that the Father would send the Spirit to guide, counsel, and<< console>> them in the truth.

modes.label: Other verbs before an object
modes.description: Verbs or particles like judge, for, on that lead into a person or group as the object.
modes.example: People needed to be saved because God was about to<< judge>> first his own people and then the pagan

modes.description: The middle of the word bullying in titles.
modes.example: Bul<<lying>> Prevention in the Age of the Internet."
